import math
import raft_node = "./raft_node.qui"

class Checker()
    violations := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    leaders := map<int, int>()
    committed_terms := [0]
    committed_times := [0]
    raft_node.Entry[] applied_entries := [raft_node.Entry(0, "NOOP", 0)]
    results := ["-"]
    elected := 0
    log_checks := 0
    pair_checks := 0
    applies := 0
    truncations := 0
    removed := 0

void leader(Checker &checker, raft_node.Node node)
    checker.elected += 1
    match checker.leaders.get(node.term)
        int existing
            if existing != node.number
                checker.violations[0] += 1
        none
            .checker.leaders.set(node.term, node.number)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#checker.committed_terms)
        if index > raft_node.last_index(node) or raft_node.term_at(node, index) != checker.committed_terms[index]
            checker.violations[1] += 1
            break

void commit(Checker &checker, int index, int term, int tick)
    if index == int(#checker.committed_terms)
        checker.committed_terms = checker.committed_terms.append(term)
        checker.committed_times = checker.committed_times.append(tick)

void apply(Checker &checker, int index, raft_node.Entry entry, string result)
    checker.applies += 1
    if index == int(#checker.applied_entries)
        checker.applied_entries = checker.applied_entries.append(entry)
        checker.results = checker.results.append(result)
    elif checker.applied_entries[index] != entry
        checker.violations[3] += 1

void truncate(Checker &checker, int first, raft_node.Entry[] entries)
    checker.truncations += 1
    checker.removed += int(#entries)
    for: offset < int(#entries)
        index := first + offset
        if index < int(#checker.committed_terms) and checker.committed_terms[index] == entries[offset].term
            checker.violations[4] += 1

void check_logs(Checker &checker, raft_node.Node[] nodes)
    checker.log_checks += 1
    for: 1 <= i < int(#nodes)
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#nodes)
            checker.pair_checks += 1
            limit := math.min(raft_node.last_index(nodes[i]), raft_node.last_index(nodes[j]))
            greatest := 0
            for: 1 <= index <= limit
                if raft_node.term_at(nodes[i], index) == raft_node.term_at(nodes[j], index)
                    greatest = index
            for: index < greatest
                if nodes[i].log[index] != nodes[j].log[index]
                    checker.violations[2] += 1
                    break

string[] property_lines(Checker checker, int maximum_term)
    names := ["ELECTION_SAFETY", "LEADER_COMPLETENESS", "LOG_MATCHING", "STATE_MACHINE_SAFETY", "COMMITTED_KEPT"]
    details := [
        "terms {maximum_term} leaders {checker.leaders.size()} elected {checker.elected}",
        "checks {checker.elected} committed {int(#checker.committed_terms) - 1}",
        "checks {checker.log_checks} pairs {checker.pair_checks}",
        "applies {checker.applies} indices {int(#checker.applied_entries) - 1}",
        "truncations {checker.truncations} removed {checker.removed}"
    ]
    string[] lines := []
    for: index < 5
        verdict := if checker.violations[index] == 0 then "OK" else "FAIL"
        lines = lines.append("{names[index]} {verdict} violations {checker.violations[index]} {details[index]}")
    return lines

class Settings(int nodes, int election_min, int election_max, int heartbeat, int batch, int quorum, int64 seed, int end, int retry, int attempts, int sample)
class Control(int tick, string kind, string[] arguments)
class Request(int number, int tick, int initial_destination, string command)
    scheduled := tick
    destination := initial_destination
    attempts := 0
    redirects := 0
    accepted_index := 0
    accepted_term := 0
    abandoned := false
    status := "WAITING"
    latency := 0
    result := "-"
class Script(Control[] controls, Request[] requests)

string[][] read_fields(string path)
    string[][] rows := []
    source := file.read(path)
    while .source(string &line)
        rows = rows.append(line.split(" "))
    return rows

Settings read_settings()
    rows := read_fields("input/cluster.txt")
    return Settings(int(rows[0][1]), int(rows[1][1]), int(rows[1][2]), int(rows[2][1]), int(rows[3][1]), int(rows[4][1]), int64(rows[5][1]), int(rows[6][1]), int(rows[7][1]), int(rows[8][1]), int(rows[9][1]))

Script read_script()
    Control[] controls := []
    Request[] requests := []
    for row := read_fields("input/script.txt")[]
        tick := int(row[0])
        if row[1] == "REQUEST"
            requests = requests.append(Request(int(#requests) + 1, tick, int(row[2]), row[3:].join(" ")))
        else
            controls = controls.append(Control(tick, row[1], row[2:]))
    return Script(controls, requests)

int[][] partition_groups(string[] arguments)
    int[][] groups := []
    for argument := arguments[]
        groups = groups.append([for item := argument.split(",")[] then int(item)])
    return groups

import math
import cluster = "./cluster.qui"
import minstd = "./minstd.qui"
import network = "./network.qui"
import raft_node = "./raft_node.qui"
import checker = "./checker.qui"

class Election(int tick, int node, int term, string trigger, bool[] votes)
    won := -1
class Leader(int node, int elected, bool[] votes)
    appended := 1
    ended := -1
    reason := "ACTIVE"
    commit := 0
class Gap(int first, int last)
class Simulation(cluster.Settings settings, cluster.Script script, network.Network net)
    raft_node.Node[] nodes := [for i := (0:(settings.nodes))[] then raft_node.Node(i, settings.nodes)]
    rng := minstd.Generator(settings.seed)
    checks := checker.Checker()
    tick := 0
    string[] trace := []
    Election[] elections := []
    leaders := map<int, Leader>()
    string[] timelines := []
    leader_ticks := 0
    multi_ticks := 0
    Gap[] gaps := []
    gap_start := -1
    maximum_term := 0
    reference_state := map<string, int>()
    map<string, int>[] reference_states := []
    status_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    int[] latencies := []
    key_requests := map<string, int>()
    key_committed := map<string, int>()

void trace(Simulation &sim, string content)
    sim.trace = sim.trace.append("{sim.tick} {content}")

void set_election_timer(Simulation &sim, int number)
    int duration := .sim.rng.between(sim.settings.election_min, sim.settings.election_max)
    sim.nodes[number].election_deadline = sim.tick + duration

Leader leader_record(Simulation sim, int term)
    match sim.leaders.get(term)
        Leader record
            return record
        none
            return Leader(0, 0, [])

void send_append(Simulation &sim, int first, int second)
    node := sim.nodes[first]
    int previous := node.next_index[second] - 1
    message := network.Message("AE", first, second, node.term)
    message.previous = previous
    message.previous_term = raft_node.term_at(node, previous)
    message.entries = node.log[previous:<math.min(previous + sim.settings.batch, raft_node.last_index(node))]
    message.commit = node.commit
    network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, message)

void broadcast_append(Simulation &sim, int number)
    for: 1 <= other <= sim.settings.nodes
        if other != number
            send_append(&sim, number, other)

void end_leadership(Simulation &sim, int number, string reason)
    node := sim.nodes[number]
    record := leader_record(sim, node.term)
    record.ended = sim.tick
    record.reason = reason
    record.commit = node.commit
    .sim.leaders.set(node.term, record)
    raft_node.cancel_transfer(&sim.nodes[number])

void advance_commit(Simulation &sim, int number, int index)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    for: node.commit + 1 <= position <= index
        checker.commit(&sim.checks, position, raft_node.term_at(node, position), sim.tick)
    node.commit = index
    first := node.applied + 1
    for: first <= int position <= index
        raft_node.Entry entry := node.log[position - 1]
        result := raft_node.apply_command(&node.store, entry.command)
        node.applies += 1
        checker.apply(&sim.checks, position, entry, result)
    node.applied = index
    trace(&sim, "APPLY n{number} {first}-{index}")

void check_commit(Simulation &sim, int number)
    node := sim.nodes[number]
    index := raft_node.last_index(node)
    while index > node.commit
        if raft_node.term_at(node, index) != node.term
            return
        count := 1
        for: 1 <= other <= sim.settings.nodes
            if other != number and node.matched[other] >= index
                count += 1
        if 2 * count > sim.settings.nodes
            trace(&sim, "COMMIT n{number} {node.commit + 1}-{index} term {node.term}")
            advance_commit(&sim, number, index)
            return
        index -= 1

void send_timeout_now(Simulation &sim, int number)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    trace(&sim, "TIMEOUTNOW n{number} n{node.transfer_target} term {node.term} index {raft_node.last_index(node)}")
    node.transfer_sent = true
    network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, network.Message("TN", number, node.transfer_target, node.term))

void become_leader(Simulation &sim, int number)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    node.role = "LEADER"
    node.known_leader = number
    node.next_index = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = raft_node.last_index(node) + 1)
    node.matched = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = 0)
    node.log = node.log.append(raft_node.Entry(node.term, "NOOP", 0))
    node.leader_terms += 1
    sim.elections[node.election_record].won = sim.tick
    checker.leader(&sim.checks, node)
    .sim.leaders.set(node.term, Leader(number, sim.tick, node.votes))
    trace(&sim, "LEADER n{number} term {node.term} votes {raft_node.node_set(node.votes)} noop {raft_node.last_index(node)}")
    broadcast_append(&sim, number)
    node.heartbeat_deadline = sim.tick + sim.settings.heartbeat
    node.quorum_deadline = sim.tick + sim.settings.quorum
    node.heard = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = false)

void start_election(Simulation &sim, int number, string trigger)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    node.term += 1
    node.role = "CANDIDATE"
    node.voted_for = number
    node.votes = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = false)
    node.votes[number] = true
    node.known_leader = 0
    set_election_timer(&sim, number)
    node.elections += 1
    node.election_record = int(#sim.elections)
    sim.elections = sim.elections.append(Election(sim.tick, number, node.term, trigger, node.votes))
    trace(&sim, "ELECTION n{number} term {node.term} last {raft_node.last_index(node)}/{raft_node.term_at(node, raft_node.last_index(node))} deadline {node.election_deadline}")
    for: 1 <= other <= sim.settings.nodes
        if other != number
            message := network.Message("RV", number, other, node.term)
            message.last_index = raft_node.last_index(node)
            message.last_term = raft_node.term_at(node, message.last_index)
            network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, message)

void vote_request(Simulation &sim, network.Message message)
    number := message.destination
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    reason := ""
    if message.term < node.term
        reason = "term"
    elif node.voted_for != 0 and node.voted_for != message.source
        reason = "voted"
    elif not raft_node.accepts_log(node, message.last_index, message.last_term)
        reason = "log"
    if reason == ""
        node.voted_for = message.source
        node.votes_granted += 1
        set_election_timer(&sim, number)
        trace(&sim, "VOTE n{number} n{message.source} term {node.term} deadline {node.election_deadline}")
    else
        trace(&sim, "DENY n{number} n{message.source} term {node.term} {reason}")
    response := network.Message("RVR", number, message.source, node.term)
    response.success = reason == ""
    network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, response)

void append_request(Simulation &sim, network.Message message)
    number := message.destination
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    response := network.Message("AER", number, message.source, node.term)
    if message.term < node.term
        network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, response)
        return
    if node.role == "CANDIDATE"
        node.role = "FOLLOWER"
        trace(&sim, "YIELD n{number} term {node.term} n{message.source}")
    node.known_leader = message.source
    set_election_timer(&sim, number)
    previous := message.previous
    if previous > raft_node.last_index(node) or raft_node.term_at(node, previous) != message.previous_term
        node.ae_fail += 1
        response.confirmed = if previous > raft_node.last_index(node) then raft_node.last_index(node) else previous - 1
        network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, response)
        return
    node.ae_ok += 1
    for: offset < int(#message.entries)
        index := previous + 1 + offset
        entry := message.entries[offset]
        if index <= raft_node.last_index(node) and raft_node.term_at(node, index) != entry.term
            raft_node.Entry[] removed := node.log[index - 1:]
            node.log = node.log[0:<index - 1]
            node.truncated += int(#removed)
            checker.truncate(&sim.checks, index, removed)
            trace(&sim, "TRUNCATE n{number} from {index} removed {#removed}")
        if index > raft_node.last_index(node)
            node.log = node.log.append(entry)
            node.appended += 1
    response.success = true
    response.confirmed = previous + int(#message.entries)
    commit := math.min(message.commit, response.confirmed)
    if commit > node.commit
        advance_commit(&sim, number, commit)
    network.send(&sim.net, sim.tick, response)

void append_response(Simulation &sim, network.Message message)
    number := message.destination
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    if node.role != "LEADER" or message.term != node.term
        return
    source := message.source
    node.heard[source] = true
    if message.success
        node.matched[source] = math.max(node.matched[source], message.confirmed)
        node.next_index[source] = math.max(node.next_index[source], message.confirmed + 1)
        check_commit(&sim, number)
        if source == node.transfer_target and not node.transfer_sent and node.matched[source] == raft_node.last_index(node)
            send_timeout_now(&sim, number)
        elif node.next_index[source] <= raft_node.last_index(node)
            send_append(&sim, number, source)
    else
        node.next_index[source] = math.max(node.matched[source] + 1, math.min(node.next_index[source] - 1, message.confirmed + 1))
        trace(&sim, "BACKTRACK n{number} n{source} next {node.next_index[source]}")
        send_append(&sim, number, source)

void receive(Simulation &sim, network.Message message)
    number := message.destination
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    if message.term > node.term
        role := node.role
        trace(&sim, "TERM n{number} {node.term}->{message.term} {message.kind} n{message.source} {role}")
        if role == "LEADER"
            end_leadership(&sim, number, "STEPDOWN")
        node.term = message.term
        node.voted_for = 0
        node.known_leader = 0
        node.role = "FOLLOWER"
        if role == "LEADER"
            set_election_timer(&sim, number)
    if message.kind == "RV"
        vote_request(&sim, message)
    elif message.kind == "RVR"
        if node.role == "CANDIDATE" and message.term == node.term and message.success
            node.votes[message.source] = true
            sim.elections[node.election_record].votes = node.votes
            if 2 * raft_node.members(node.votes) > sim.settings.nodes
                become_leader(&sim, number)
    elif message.kind == "AE"
        append_request(&sim, message)
    elif message.kind == "AER"
        append_response(&sim, message)
    elif message.term != node.term or node.role != "FOLLOWER"
        trace(&sim, "IGNORE n{number} TN n{message.source} term {message.term}")
    else
        start_election(&sim, number, "transfer")

void start_transfer(Simulation &sim, int number, int destination)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    prefix := "TRANSFER n{number} n{destination}"
    if not node.up or node.role != "LEADER" or node.transfer_target != 0 or number == destination
        trace(&sim, prefix + " ignored")
        return
    trace(&sim, "{prefix} start match {node.matched[destination]}/{raft_node.last_index(node)}")
    node.transfer_target = destination
    node.transfer_sent = false
    node.transfer_deadline = sim.tick + sim.settings.election_min
    if node.matched[destination] == raft_node.last_index(node)
        send_timeout_now(&sim, number)
    else
        send_append(&sim, number, destination)

void control(Simulation &sim, cluster.Control event)
    if event.kind == "CRASH"
        number := int(event.arguments[0])
        trace(&sim, "CRASH n{number} {sim.nodes[number].role} term {sim.nodes[number].term}")
        if sim.nodes[number].role == "LEADER"
            end_leadership(&sim, number, "CRASH")
        raft_node.crash(&sim.nodes[number])
    elif event.kind == "RESTART"
        number := int(event.arguments[0])
        sim.nodes[number].up = true
        set_election_timer(&sim, number)
        trace(&sim, "RESTART n{number} term {sim.nodes[number].term} length {raft_node.last_index(sim.nodes[number])} deadline {sim.nodes[number].election_deadline}")
    elif event.kind == "PARTITION"
        groups := cluster.partition_groups(event.arguments)
        network.partition(&sim.net, groups)
        string[] names := []
        for group := groups[]
            flags := array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = false)
            for number := group[]
                flags[number] = true
            names = names.append(raft_node.node_set(flags))
        trace(&sim, "PARTITION " + names.join(" "))
    elif event.kind == "HEAL"
        sim.net.groups = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = 0)
        trace(&sim, "HEAL")
    else
        start_transfer(&sim, int(event.arguments[0]), int(event.arguments[1]))

void attempt(Simulation &sim, int request_index)
    &request := &sim.script.requests[request_index]
    request.attempts += 1
    int destination := request.destination
    redirects := 0
    reason := ""
    while true
        &node := &sim.nodes[destination]
        if not node.up
            reason = "down"
            break
        if node.role == "LEADER"
            if node.transfer_target != 0
                reason = "transfer"
                break
            node.log = node.log.append(raft_node.Entry(node.term, request.command, request.number))
            record := leader_record(sim, node.term)
            record.appended += 1
            .sim.leaders.set(node.term, record)
            request.accepted_index = raft_node.last_index(node)
            request.accepted_term = node.term
            request.scheduled = -1
            trace(&sim, "ACCEPT r{request.number} n{destination} index {request.accepted_index} term {node.term}")
            return
        if node.known_leader == 0 or redirects >= sim.settings.nodes - 1
            reason = "noleader"
            break
        trace(&sim, "REDIRECT r{request.number} n{destination} n{node.known_leader}")
        destination = node.known_leader
        redirects += 1
        request.redirects += 1
    prefix := "REJECT r{request.number} n{destination} {reason}"
    if request.attempts < sim.settings.attempts
        request.destination = destination % sim.settings.nodes + 1
        request.scheduled = sim.tick + sim.settings.retry
        trace(&sim, "{prefix} retry n{request.destination} at {request.scheduled}")
    else
        request.abandoned = true
        request.scheduled = -1
        trace(&sim, prefix + " giveup")

void timers(Simulation &sim, int number)
    &node := &sim.nodes[number]
    if node.role == "LEADER"
        if node.quorum_deadline == sim.tick
            if 2 * (1 + raft_node.members(node.heard)) <= sim.settings.nodes
                trace(&sim, "STEPDOWN n{number} term {node.term} heard {raft_node.node_set(node.heard)}")
                end_leadership(&sim, number, "QUORUM")
                node.role = "FOLLOWER"
                node.known_leader = 0
                set_election_timer(&sim, number)
                return
            node.heard = array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = false)
            node.quorum_deadline = sim.tick + sim.settings.quorum
        if node.transfer_target != 0 and node.transfer_deadline == sim.tick
            trace(&sim, "TRANSFER n{number} n{node.transfer_target} abort")
            raft_node.cancel_transfer(&node)
        if node.heartbeat_deadline == sim.tick
            broadcast_append(&sim, number)
            node.heartbeat_deadline = sim.tick + sim.settings.heartbeat
    elif node.election_deadline == sim.tick
        start_election(&sim, number, "timeout")

void end_of_tick(Simulation &sim)
    checker.check_logs(&sim.checks, sim.nodes)
    count := 0
    string[] fields := []
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        &node := &sim.nodes[number]
        if node.up and node.role == "LEADER"
            node.leader_ticks += 1
            count += 1
        state := if node.up then node.role[0] else "D"
        fields = fields.append("{state}{node.term}")
    if count > 0
        sim.leader_ticks += 1
        if count >= 2
            sim.multi_ticks += 1
        if sim.gap_start >= 0
            sim.gaps = sim.gaps.append(Gap(sim.gap_start, sim.tick - 1))
            sim.gap_start = -1
    elif sim.gap_start < 0
        sim.gap_start = sim.tick
    if sim.tick % sim.settings.sample == 0
        sim.timelines = sim.timelines.append("TIMELINE {sim.tick} " + fields.join(" "))

void finish_statistics(Simulation &sim)
    committed_count := int(#sim.checks.committed_terms) - 1
    sim.reference_states = [sim.reference_state]
    for: 1 <= index <= committed_count
        unused := raft_node.apply_command(&sim.reference_state, sim.checks.applied_entries[index].command)
        sim.reference_states = sim.reference_states.append(sim.reference_state)
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        sim.maximum_term = math.max(sim.maximum_term, sim.nodes[number].term)
    for: request_index < int(#sim.script.requests)
        &request := &sim.script.requests[request_index]
        string key := request.command.split(" ")[1]
        .sim.key_requests.set(key, raft_node.value_or_zero(sim.key_requests, key) + 1)
        status := 4
        int index := request.accepted_index
        if index > 0
            if index <= committed_count and sim.checks.committed_terms[index] == request.accepted_term
                status = 0
                request.status = "COMMITTED"
                request.latency = sim.checks.committed_times[index] - request.tick
                request.result = sim.checks.results[index]
                sim.latencies = sim.latencies.append(request.latency)
                .sim.key_committed.set(key, raft_node.value_or_zero(sim.key_committed, key) + 1)
            else
                status = 2
                request.status = "LOST"
                for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
                    if raft_node.last_index(sim.nodes[number]) >= index and raft_node.term_at(sim.nodes[number], index) == request.accepted_term
                        status = 1
                        request.status = "UNCOMMITTED"
                        break
        elif request.abandoned
            status = 3
            request.status = "FAILED"
        sim.status_counts[status] += 1

void run(Simulation &sim)
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        set_election_timer(&sim, number)
        trace(&sim, "START n{number} deadline {sim.nodes[number].election_deadline}")
    for: tick <= sim.settings.end
        sim.tick = tick
        for event := sim.script.controls[]
            if event.tick == tick
                control(&sim, event)
        for: request_index < int(#sim.script.requests)
            if sim.script.requests[request_index].scheduled == tick
                attempt(&sim, request_index)
        for message := network.arrivals(&sim.net, tick)[]
            if network.deliver(&sim.net, message, sim.nodes[message.destination].up)
                receive(&sim, message)
        for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
            if sim.nodes[number].up
                timers(&sim, number)
        end_of_tick(&sim)
    if sim.gap_start >= 0
        sim.gaps = sim.gaps.append(Gap(sim.gap_start, sim.settings.end))
    finish_statistics(&sim)

string[] leader_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := []
    for record := sim.elections[]
        outcome := if record.won >= 0 then "WON {record.won}" else "LOST"
        lines = lines.append("ELECTION {record.tick} n{record.node} term {record.term} trigger {record.trigger} votes {raft_node.members(record.votes)} {outcome}")
    for: 1 <= term <= sim.maximum_term
        candidates := array(nat(sim.settings.nodes + 1), fill = false)
        start := -1
        for election := sim.elections[]
            if election.term == term
                candidates[election.node] = true
                if start < 0
                    start = election.tick
        names := raft_node.node_set(candidates)
        if not sim.leaders.has(term)
            lines = lines.append("TERM {term} NONE candidates {names}")
            continue
        record := leader_record(sim, term)
        ended := if record.ended < 0 then "-" else "{record.ended}"
        commit := if record.ended < 0 then sim.nodes[record.node].commit else record.commit
        lines = lines.append("TERM {term} LEADER n{record.node} elected {record.elected} votes {raft_node.node_set(record.votes)} ended {ended} {record.reason} appended {record.appended} commit {commit} candidates {names} started {start} wait {record.elected - start}")
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        node := sim.nodes[number]
        lines = lines.append("NODE n{number} elections {node.elections} leader_terms {node.leader_terms} leader_ticks {node.leader_ticks} votes_granted {node.votes_granted}")
    lines = lines.concat(sim.timelines)
    longest := 0
    for gap := sim.gaps[]
        length := gap.last - gap.first + 1
        longest = math.max(longest, length)
        lines = lines.append("GAP {gap.first}-{gap.last} length {length}")
    lines = lines.append("SUMMARY terms {sim.maximum_term} leaders {sim.leaders.size()} elections {#sim.elections} leader_ticks {sim.leader_ticks} multi_ticks {sim.multi_ticks} ticks {sim.settings.end + 1} gaps {#sim.gaps} longest {longest}")
    return lines

string[] log_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := []
    prefix := raft_node.last_index(sim.nodes[1])
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        node := sim.nodes[number]
        status := if node.up then node.role else "DOWN"
        voted := if node.voted_for == 0 then "-" else "n{node.voted_for}"
        lines = lines.append("NODE n{number} {status} term {node.term} voted {voted} commit {node.commit} applied {node.applied} length {raft_node.last_index(node)}")
        for: offset < int(#node.log)
            raft_node.Entry entry := node.log[offset]
            suffix := if entry.request == 0 then "" else " r{entry.request}"
            lines = lines.append("{offset + 1} {entry.term} {entry.command}{suffix}")
        prefix = math.min(prefix, raft_node.last_index(node))
        common := 0
        while common < prefix and node.log[common] == sim.nodes[1].log[common]
            common += 1
        prefix = common
    count := int(#sim.checks.committed_terms) - 1
    lines = lines.append("AGREE prefix {prefix} committed {count}")
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        node := sim.nodes[number]
        common := 0
        while common < math.min(raft_node.last_index(node), count) and raft_node.term_at(node, common + 1) == sim.checks.committed_terms[common + 1]
            common += 1
        lines = lines.append("DIFF n{number} common {common} behind {count - common} extra {raft_node.last_index(node) - common} ae_ok {node.ae_ok} ae_fail {node.ae_fail} appended {node.appended} truncated {node.truncated} applies {node.applies}")
    return lines

bool same_store(map<string, int> first, map<string, int> second)
    if first.size() != second.size()
        return false
    for key := first.keys()[]
        if not second.has(key) or raft_node.value_or_zero(first, key) != raft_node.value_or_zero(second, key)
            return false
    return true

string[] state_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := []
    for: 1 <= number <= sim.settings.nodes
        node := sim.nodes[number]
        status := if node.up then "UP" else "DOWN"
        replay := if same_store(node.store, sim.reference_states[node.applied]) then "match" else "mismatch"
        lines = lines.append("NODE n{number} {status} applied {node.applied} keys {node.store.size()} replay {replay}")
        for key := node.store.keys().sorted()[]
            lines = lines.append("{key} {raft_node.value_or_zero(node.store, key)}")
    for request := sim.script.requests[]
        line := "REQUEST r{request.number} at {request.tick} n{request.initial_destination} {request.command} attempts {request.attempts} redirects {request.redirects} "
        if request.accepted_index > 0
            line += "{request.status} index {request.accepted_index} term {request.accepted_term}"
            if request.status == "COMMITTED"
                line += " latency {request.latency} result {request.result}"
        elif request.abandoned
            line += "FAILED"
        else
            line += "WAITING next {request.scheduled}"
        lines = lines.append(line)
    for key := sim.key_requests.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("KEY {key} requests {raft_node.value_or_zero(sim.key_requests, key)} committed {raft_node.value_or_zero(sim.key_committed, key)} final {raft_node.value_text(sim.reference_state, key)}")
    int[] counts := sim.status_counts
    lines = lines.append("REQUESTS total {#sim.script.requests} committed {counts[0]} uncommitted {counts[1]} lost {counts[2]} failed {counts[3]} waiting {counts[4]}")
    total := 0
    minimum := 0
    maximum := 0
    for: i < int(#sim.latencies)
        value := sim.latencies[i]
        total += value
        minimum = if i == 0 then value else math.min(minimum, value)
        maximum = math.max(maximum, value)
    lines = lines.append("LATENCY count {#sim.latencies} total {total} min {minimum} max {maximum}")
    return lines

string[] safety_lines(Simulation sim)
    lines := checker.property_lines(sim.checks, sim.maximum_term)
    lines = lines.append("MESSAGES " + network.statistics(sim.net.total))
    types := network.type_names()
    for: kind < 5
        lines = lines.append("TYPE {types[kind]} " + network.statistics(sim.net.by_type[kind]))
    for: 1 <= first <= sim.settings.nodes
        for: 1 <= second <= sim.settings.nodes
            if first == second
                continue
            network.Link link := sim.net.links[first][second]
            int dropped := link.stats[3] + link.stats[4] + link.stats[5] + link.stats[6]
            lines = lines.append("LINK n{first}->n{second} delay {link.delay} loss {link.loss} sent {link.stats[0]} delivered {link.stats[1]} dropped {dropped}")
    lines = lines.append("DRAWS {sim.rng.draws}")
    safe := true
    for violations := sim.checks.violations[]
        if violations > 0
            safe = false
    lines = lines.append(if safe then "RESULT SAFE" else "RESULT UNSAFE")
    return lines

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    destination := file.write("output/" + filename)
    .destination(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    settings := cluster.read_settings()
    sim := Simulation(settings, cluster.read_script(), network.read_network(settings.nodes))
    run(&sim)
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("trace.txt", sim.trace)
    write_lines("leaders.txt", leader_lines(sim))
    write_lines("logs.txt", log_lines(sim))
    write_lines("state.txt", state_lines(sim))
    write_lines("safety.txt", safety_lines(sim))

run_program()

import cluster = "./cluster.qui"
import raft_node = "./raft_node.qui"

class Message(string kind, int source, int destination, int term)
    last_index := 0
    last_term := 0
    previous := 0
    previous_term := 0
    raft_node.Entry[] entries := []
    commit := 0
    success := false
    confirmed := 0
class Drop(string kind, int first, int last)
class Link(int delay)
    loss := 0
    passed := 0
    Drop[] drops := []
    stats := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
class Pending(int arrival, int serial, Message message)
class Network(int count, Link[][] links)
    groups := array(nat(count + 1), fill = 0)
    total := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    int[][] by_type := [for i := (int(0):<5)[] then [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]]
    Pending[] pending := []
    serial := 0

string[] type_names()
    return ["RV", "RVR", "AE", "AER", "TN"]

int type_index(string kind)
    names := type_names()
    for: index < 5
        if names[index] == kind
            return index
    return 4

Network read_network(int count)
    rows := cluster.read_fields("input/network.txt")
    default_delay := int(rows[0][1])
    links := [for first := (0:count)[] then [for second := (0:count)[] then Link(default_delay)]]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#rows)
        row := rows[i]
        for: 1 <= first <= count
            for: 1 <= second <= count
                if first == second or (row[1] != "*" and row[1] != "{first}") or (row[2] != "*" and row[2] != "{second}")
                    continue
                if row[0] == "DELAY"
                    links[first][second].delay = int(row[3])
                elif row[0] == "LOSS"
                    links[first][second].loss = int(row[3])
                else
                    links[first][second].drops = links[first][second].drops.append(Drop(row[3], int(row[4]), int(row[5])))
    return Network(count, links)

void partition(Network &network, int[][] groups)
    for: i < int(#groups)
        for number := groups[i][]
            network.groups[number] = i

void count_message(Network &network, Message message, int field, amount := 1)
    network.total[field] += amount
    network.by_type[type_index(message.kind)][field] += amount
    network.links[message.source][message.destination].stats[field] += amount

void send(Network &network, int tick, Message message)
    network.serial += 1
    count_message(&network, message, 0)
    first := message.source
    second := message.destination
    if network.groups[first] != network.groups[second]
        count_message(&network, message, 3)
        return
    for drop := network.links[first][second].drops[]
        if (drop.kind == message.kind or drop.kind == "ALL") and drop.first <= tick and tick <= drop.last
            count_message(&network, message, 4)
            return
    network.links[first][second].passed += 1
    link := network.links[first][second]
    if link.loss > 0 and link.passed % link.loss == 0
        count_message(&network, message, 5)
        return
    count_message(&network, message, 2)
    network.pending = network.pending.append(Pending(tick + link.delay, network.serial, message))

Message[] arrivals(Network &network, int tick)
    Pending[] due := []
    Pending[] future := []
    for item := network.pending[]
        if item.arrival == tick
            due = due.append(item)
            count_message(&network, item.message, 2, -1)
        else
            future = future.append(item)
    network.pending = future
    for: 1 <= i < int(#due)
        item := due[i]
        j := i
        while j > 0 and (due[j - 1].message.source > item.message.source or (due[j - 1].message.source == item.message.source and due[j - 1].serial > item.serial))
            due[j] = due[j - 1]
            j -= 1
        due[j] = item
    return [for item := due[] then item.message]

bool deliver(Network &network, Message message, bool destination_up)
    if not destination_up
        count_message(&network, message, 6)
        return false
    if network.groups[message.source] != network.groups[message.destination]
        count_message(&network, message, 3)
        return false
    count_message(&network, message, 1)
    return true

string statistics(int[] values)
    fields := ["sent", "delivered", "inflight", "partition", "rule", "loss", "down"]
    return [for i := (int(0):<7)[] then "{fields[i]} {values[i]}"].join(" ")

class Entry(int term, string command, int request)

class Node(int number, local int count)
    term := 0
    voted_for := 0
    Entry[] log := []
    up := true
    role := "FOLLOWER"
    commit := 0
    applied := 0
    store := map<string, int>()
    known_leader := 0
    votes := array(nat(count + 1), fill = false)
    election_deadline := -1
    election_record := -1
    next_index := array(nat(count + 1), fill = 0)
    matched := array(nat(count + 1), fill = 0)
    heartbeat_deadline := -1
    quorum_deadline := -1
    heard := array(nat(count + 1), fill = false)
    transfer_target := 0
    transfer_sent := false
    transfer_deadline := -1
    elections := 0
    leader_terms := 0
    votes_granted := 0
    leader_ticks := 0
    ae_ok := 0
    ae_fail := 0
    appended := 0
    truncated := 0
    applies := 0

int last_index(Node node)
    return int(#node.log)

int term_at(Node node, int index)
    return if index == 0 then 0 else node.log[index - 1].term

bool accepts_log(Node node, int candidate_index, int candidate_term)
    latest_term := term_at(node, last_index(node))
    return candidate_term > latest_term or (candidate_term == latest_term and candidate_index >= last_index(node))

void cancel_transfer(Node &node)
    node.transfer_target = 0
    node.transfer_sent = false
    node.transfer_deadline = -1

void crash(Node &node)
    node.up = false
    node.role = "FOLLOWER"
    node.commit = 0
    node.applied = 0
    node.store = map<string, int>()
    node.known_leader = 0
    node.votes = array(#node.votes, fill = false)
    node.election_deadline = -1
    node.election_record = -1
    node.next_index = array(#node.next_index, fill = 0)
    node.matched = array(#node.matched, fill = 0)
    node.heartbeat_deadline = -1
    node.quorum_deadline = -1
    node.heard = array(#node.heard, fill = false)
    cancel_transfer(&node)

int value_or_zero(map<string, int> store, string key)
    match store.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

string value_text(map<string, int> store, string key)
    match store.get(key)
        int value
            return "{value}"
        none
            return "missing"

string apply_command(map<string, int> &store, string command)
    fields := command.split(" ")
    if fields[0] == "NOOP"
        return "-"
    key := fields[1]
    if fields[0] == "SET"
        .store.set(key, int(fields[2]))
        return "ok"
    if fields[0] == "ADD"
        int value := value_or_zero(store, key) + int(fields[2])
        .store.set(key, value)
        return "{value}"
    if fields[0] == "DEL"
        bool removed := .store.remove(key)
        return if removed then "deleted" else "missing"
    return value_text(store, key)

int members(bool[] flags)
    result := 0
    for flag := flags[]
        if flag
            result += 1
    return result

string node_set(bool[] flags)
    string[] parts := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#flags)
        if flags[i]
            parts = parts.append("n{i}")
    return if #parts == 0 then "-" else parts.join(",")
